Here’s what I’ve had my @ChatGPT  Dots help me with over the past two weeks. Too much so I ask dots to pick some, besides coding and research:

1）Organize daycare updates
Save daily meals, naps, activities, and photos to Craft. When photos fail to download or go missing, go back, fill in the gaps, and check that they actually show up.

2）Keep a daily work log
Track what’s done, what’s still in progress, and what’s waiting on a reply. Save it to Craft and update the records when I give it new information. No digging through old chats myself.

3）Filter physical mail
Actually look at USPS envelope previews, check who they’re addressed to, and filter out ads and mail for previous residents. Flag the tax, insurance, and DMV letters worth paying attention to.

4）Find deals and place orders
Compare places to buy Stelo, find a better deal with a discount, and place the order. Also track gift card cashback for brands like Starbucks and Target, and only ping me when there’s a new increase.

5）Handle returns, refunds, and subscriptions
Chat with Amazon and the NEMIX seller to sort out conflicting return instructions and get free return shipping confirmed in writing. Follow up on an OWC refund. Contact GNC and cross-check the records to find that a refund had already arrived. Cancel unwanted Blue Bottle and Amazon subscriptions.

6）Deal with app support
Dots notifications, Bartender menu bar issues, Exist tags, Bevel chat glitches, Claude folder permissions. Put together reproduction steps, submit reports, answer follow-up questions, and track replies. Saves me from explaining the same problem over and over.

7）Troubleshoot health data syncing
Help work through sync failures, missing Apple Health writes, and duplicate records across Stelo and Bevel. Follow up on support replies until I confirmed health data was writing again.

8）Prepare tax mailings
Check documents and mailing addresses, prepare shipping labels, and sort out the post office steps, postmarks, and receipts before I go.

9）Organize appointment notes and recordings
File visit records, combine notes, and add follow-ups to the calendar. Find the relevant part of a recording and cut out a short clip so I can listen to it directly.

10）Reschedule appointments
Find available slots, move two Quest appointments together, replace the old bookings, and check the calendar updates. Actually make the change, not just send me a booking link.

11）Organize insurance renewal paperwork
Download official notices, file them, and turn the renewal process into specific tasks with dates: documents, information checks, submission, and follow-up.

12）File daycare bills
Find the MyProcare PDFs, rename them by month, save them to the right Dropbox folder, check the files, and close the Todoist task.

13）Fix the wine cellar connection
Identify the wrong integration, remove it, keep the correct one, and verify that it can actually read my inventory. (wine inventory is built by dots too)
